description: New batch, 1st connection. part08-02-makei-probe2's 6 connections proved makei build works from scratch and skips genuinely-unchanged rebuilds, but never tested the actual lesson scenario: rebuilding a ZAISRV that ALREADY exists but was built the traditional (member-based CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM) way, not by makei itself - the same situation 08-01 tested for JUCSRV. Uses the empty &LIB2 (<USER>B) as a sandbox: first builds ZAISRV into &LIB2 via plain CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM from &LIB's own QRPGLESRC/QSRVSRC members (mirroring Part 7's real build method exactly, so &LIB2 now holds a 'pre-existing, non-makei-built' ZAISRV), then runs makei build (flat layout, same recipe already proven in part08-02-makei-probe2) targeting the same &LIB2 to see whether it rebuilds, skips, or fails against an object makei has never tracked before. Then edits zaisrv.rpgle (python3 binary-mode append, the safe recipe already established) and runs makei build again to confirm a real source change triggers a real rebuild. Cleans up &LIB2 afterward.

steps.label: TRADBUILD
steps.cmd:
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB2/ZAISRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ZAISRV)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) MODULE(&LIB2/ZAISRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(ZAISRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) ACTGRP(*CALLER)

steps.label: SETUP
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mk9"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk9/z"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
cat > "$HOME/mk9/z/Rules.mk" <<'RULESEOF'
ZAISRV.MODULE: zaisrv.rpgle
ZAISRV.SRVPGM: ZAISRV.MODULE zaisrv.bnd
RULESEOF
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk9/z/iproj.json','wb').write(b'{\"version\":\"0.0.1\",\"objlib\":\"&LIB2\",\"curlib\":\"&LIB2\"}')"
cat "$HOME/mk9/z/iproj.json" </dev/null
echo

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB, OBJTEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE

steps.label: EDITSRC
steps.cmd:
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "p='$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.rpgle'; d=open(p,'rb').read(); open(p,'wb').write(d + b'\n// verify-probe touch: force a source change\n')"
tail -c 80 "$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.rpgle" </dev/null
echo

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE
